inventory.title: Svalbard glacier inventory based on Sentinel-2 imagery from summer 2020, v. 1
inventory.summary:
This dataset presents the first version of a complete glacier inventory of Svalbard for the year 2020 (GI_2020_v1), comprising glacier outlines digitized from a mosaic of Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery covering all of Svalbard, acquired in July-September 2020 during an unusually warm summer with maximal snowmelt. It is an update of a previous complete GI based on satellite imagery from 2000-2010 (Nuth et al., 2013; König et al., 2013) which has been the reference dataset for Svalbard glacier outlines in GLIMS Glacier Database and the Randolph Glacier Inventory. Earlier GIs based on aerial imagery with partial coverage are also available from the same source, as well as from a study of historical 1930s imagery by Geyman et al. (2022). Divides between glacier units flowing from icefields and icecaps were updated using a digital elevation model covering the period 2008-2012 (NPI, 2014). 

This version has been updated in a new version (Kohler et al 2026).
